hotels.title: Dresden Stylish City Stay Minutes from Royal Palace
hotels.description: A contemporary stay in the heart of Dresden's historical centre, Hotel Indigo Dresden - Wettiner Platz, an IHG Hotel, brings the treasures of this heritage city within easy reach. Wake refreshed in a stylish guest room with sumptuous bedding before starting your morning revitalising your body at the fitness centre. End your day with a tasty snack or cocktail at VOLT bar. Experience the art and culture Dresden has to offer from this cultured gateway.

hotels.title: Germany: Dresden Baroque Palatial Heritage with Onsite Restaurants, Bars & Spa
hotels.description: Located within a grand Baroque palace in the heart of Dresden's historic centre, this address places the Zwinger Palace, Semper Opera House and Royal Palace within easy reach. The Frauenkirche rises nearby, while the Elbe riverbank promenade offers a scenic route through the city, framed throughout by ornate façades and cobbled streets. Inside, guests can unwind in a spa featuring a pool, saunas, a steam bath and a fitness area. Dining options span from elegant restaurants to a pâtisserie, an inviting lounge and Bar 1705. Just beyond, the surrounding quarter brims with museums, galleries and historic churches, ready to be explored.
